caveats: changed_since_r5 compares FIRE LOGIC (S6-B3235): the strategy's body and every function, module constant and config value it reaches - a delegation to another signals module included - with docstrings and the signals_used / context-bullet payload removed, against the R5-era code; a reviewed fire-neutral change (FIRE_NEUTRAL_CHANGES) counts only once its digest goes stale. An UPPER BOUND on behaviour (a configurable-span swap identical at its default counts) and blind to the producers that compute the signals
stream TIGHTEN rests on a source pattern for numeric comparisons, a LOWER BOUND - thresholds via a helper or a config constant are invisible

survives_pct calls the LIVE strategy function on each fire's persisted signals (S6-B2814; validated: reproduces 151/2933 and 1880/1880 exactly). A LOWER BOUND where a gate leg reads a key some fires did not persist; an erroring row counts as non-survival. S6-B3239: a SIDE whose gate reads a key absent from EVERY one of its R5 fires is UNMEASURED - its survival is None, unmeasured_gate_keys names the keys, the strategy's survives_pct covers its measured sides only (None when it has none), and the current-gate projection keeps that side's RAW share; None otherwise only for zero-fire strategies

the campaign lanes read the OWNER-OPENED register (output_audit/owner_campaign_opens.json, S6-B3194): a listed strategy is IN-CAMPAIGN while one of its register tickets is non-terminal (B2829) and STALLED-CAMPAIGN once every one is terminal (B2833, owner-approved 2026-09-15); an unlisted strategy is NOT-STARTED whatever tickets mention it - a mention is not a campaign (the vocabulary heuristic this replaces labelled 44 strategies and 4 were campaign subjects); mention_tickets keeps the full mention list
stream and the proj column use the CURRENT-GATE projection (raw projection x survives_pct, B2822); projected_step1_fires in this JSON keeps the raw figure

r5_exit_cube (S6-B3258 (b)) is read from the committed record output_audit/b3258_exit_cube_coverage_r5.json and checked against this build's closed-fire counts: the CLOSED R5 fires that carry a row in the exit cube (trade_exit_detail.csv), which every re-grade over exits reads - r5_fires counts the trade log, open fires included; None means no closed fire

terminal statuses (ADMITTED / DISABLED / PRUNED-DUPLICATE / CLOSED-NEGATIVE / CONTAINED) are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with the stream lanes and excluded from every work bucket (B2825); reopen_candidate flags a terminal row whose entry condition changed since its closure evidence (survives < 1.0) - flagged for the owner, never auto-reopened

IN-ROSTER-FUNNEL / IN-ROSTER-MIRROR (S6-B3135) come from scripts/phase1b_membership.py: a graded 3-cube funnel cell is on the Phase 1B roster, terminal like an admission and CLOSED to re-testing like one (owner 2026-09-29, '2 yes. No more retesting'); a short mirror retained by the owner's mirror policy is on the roster, UNGRADED beyond R5, and terminal since the owner dropped its Step 2 (S6-B2420, 2026-10-20)

DONE-OWNER-CLOSED (S6-B3135a) is a campaign the owner closed outright, read from output_audit/owner_campaign_closures.json with the owner's words; it outranks the mirror lane, so IN-ROSTER-MIRROR is exactly the mirrors the owner has not closed. A closed mirror stays ON the Phase 1B roster - the closure ends its campaign, not its membership

CLOSED-NO-READ (S6-B3303 (a), owner 2026-10-26) is a campaign the owner closed without spending its Step-2 read, read from the campaign log's T6 NOT SPENT entries; terminal and never flagged for reopening - DONE-OWNER-CLOSED outranks it

isolated_step1_check (S6-B3306 (a)) carries, where an ISOLATED Step-1 cube exists, its production-gate LONG fires against R5's on the same 200 tickers and window (output_audit/b3306_r5_fire_gap_rca.json); the R5 projection still drives every lane - re-basing it is the owner's option (b)
